scope: mathematical Hplus-connected references; not certified physical states

policy.interpretation: mathematical Hplus-connected references; not certified physical states
policy.seed_rule: original-product Xplus times the predeclared Hplus eigenvector, then Xdagger
policy.assignment: rectangular maximum sum of squared overlaps, one selected label per column
policy.tracked_objects: only the one/two mapped states at each spin, not arbitrarily labelled high states
policy.gap_interval_bound: min(endpoint selected gap)-norm(K)*dt-2*residual_tolerance; valid for fixed energy-rank labels and the linear Hermitian path
policy.zero_coupling_control: evaluate hamiltonian_at(system,0) along a five-point dummy path
policy.failure_policy: Refine on rank jumps, small overlaps, ties, unbounded intervening gaps, or unconverged common-grid diagnostics. At cap retain unresolved status and tentative candidates; do not call them unique continued labels.

boundaries: No refit, physical-state certification, original-code certification, EM or transfer prediction.
Three minima have no active bounds, but originate from finite declared fitting bounds.
Tracking labels remain those of the predeclared t0 Hplus states.
The source's physical-particle/hole versus BCS-sign issue remains explicit and unresolved.
